events.description: Temporary impairment of Auction-Rate Securities (ARS) held by the Company, resulting in a $16.0 million unrealized loss recorded in accumulated other comprehensive loss due to failed auctions starting in late February 2008
events.source_quote: As of March 31, 2008, the Company recorded an unrealized loss of $16.0 million related to the temporary impairment of the ARSs, which was included in accumulated other comprehensive loss within stockholders’ equity.

events.description: Reclassification of Auction-Rate Securities (ARS) from short-term to long-term marketable securities on the balance sheet due to liquidity issues
events.source_quote: During the quarter ended March 31, 2008, the Company reclassified its ARSs from short-term marketable securities to long-term marketable securities on its consolidated balance sheet due to management's estimate of its inability to liquidate these investments within the next twelve months.
